about: Download the demo to play 2 hours of coop mode.
SEQUEL TO THE 1 RATED SHOOTER OF 2012*

2014 Winner Best Shooter -  the Game Awards In Far Cry 4, players find themselves in Kyrat, a breathtaking, perilous and wild region of the Himalayas struggling under the regime of a despotic self-appointed king.
Using a vast array of weapons, vehicles, and animals, players will write their own story across an exotic open-world landscape.
